capacity.environment: local protocol rehearsal; not production capacity certification
capacity.dashboardMode: six-source periodic refresh with production incremental event reader; no realtime subscription
capacity.requestUnits: student/auth HTTP requests plus overlapping logical dashboard source and refresh timings; not an HTTP total

caveats: Shared database deltas include fixture preparation and background services
Consult captured settings before interpreting zero planning/I/O timings; WAL counters cover the entire database including fixture provisioning
Statement execution excludes network, pool waiting and some transaction overhead
One-second activity samples can miss short waits
Gateway upstream includes API queueing and SQL, not pure execution
Database statistics overlap fixture preparation and do not correlate per request
